global: Golden-brown, glossy tonkotsu broth with oil sheen and green flecks swirls around noodles. White ceramic bowl with a textured rim sits on a light brown wooden table, featuring dark green nori, pinkish chashu pork, pale yellow menma, and pale pink naruto fish cake.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, forming a circular boundary around the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and toppings with visible oil sheen and scattered green flecks.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish-white meat, visible marbling, and a sesame-seeded surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale pink swirls in translucent white, smooth surface with faint speckles, roundish shape.
